name: Squash / intraoperative cytology
use: Intraoperative CNS diagnosis, lesional tissue confirmation.

adequacy.title: Adequacy
items: Tiny tissue fragments smeared between slides; rapid H&E/toluidine blue.

diagnoses.name: Gliosis / non-lesional brain
diagnoses.final: Reactive glial tissue; lesional tissue not identified.

categories.name: Lesional – diagnosis
criteria: Glial fibrillary background, Rosenthal fibres, whorls, epithelial clusters, lymphoid cells.

diagnoses.name: Meningioma
diagnoses.comment: Syncytial whorls, nuclear pseudoinclusions and psammoma bodies; grading needs histology (mitoses, brain invasion).

diagnoses.name: Metastatic carcinoma
diagnoses.comment: Cohesive epithelial clusters sharply separate from glial background; correlate with known primary; IHC on permanent sections.

diagnoses.name: Lymphoma
diagnoses.final: Atypical lymphoid cells – lymphoma favoured; avoid freezing artefact, save tissue for flow.
diagnoses.comment: Discohesive atypical lymphoid cells with lymphoglandular bodies, often angiocentric; hold steroids if possible and send fresh tissue for flow cytometry.

diagnoses.name: Pituitary adenoma (PitNET)
diagnoses.comment: Monotonous round cells with salt-and-pepper chromatin, loss of normal acinar mix; transcription-factor IHC on permanent sections.

diagnoses.name: Schwannoma
diagnoses.comment: Cohesive fascicles of wavy spindle cells, Verocay-like palisades; S100/SOX10 confirm; vestibular location typical.

extra.title: Status
items: Consensus/descriptive – no official international reporting system.

references: Burger PC. Smears and Frozen Sections in Surgical Neuropathology: A Manual. PB Medical Publishing, 2009.
Koss' Diagnostic Cytology and Its Histopathologic Bases. 5th ed. 2006.
